text.fuckinguselessmod.config.title: Fucking Useless Mod Configuration
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.descriptio: Enable or disable the mod's chat transformations.
Choose how transformed text is applied to chat messages.
Choose how block characters are selected when block effects are enabled.
Choose the encoding steps used in Encode mode. The order of the steps matters.
Number of bit positions to rotate during the bit rotation step. Range: 0-7.
Byte value used by the bitwise XOR encoding step. Range: 0-255.
Apply Zalgo corruption to transformed text.
Chance for Zalgo corruption to be applied to a transformed message. Range: 0.0-1.0.
Allow block-character effects to appear in transformed text.
Chance for a block-character effect to be applied to a transformed message. Range: 0.0-1.0.
Maximum length of the transformed message. Range: 1-256.
Presets to apply to transformed text. Entries must match available preset names.
Apply the dedicated Uwuifier transformation to chat messages.
Choose whether transformed text preserves its case, becomes lowercase, or becomes uppercase.
Replace R and L sounds with W, including uppercase variants.
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.option.uwu: Replace N + Vowel with Ny + Vowel
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.descriptio: Turn sequences such as "na" and "no" into "nya" and "nyo".
Replace "ove" with "uv", a common Uwuifier-style spelling change.
Replace "th" with "d". Disabled by default.
Replace "you" with "yuo". Disabled by default.
Occasionally repeat the beginning of a word with a hyphen.
Chance of adding a stutter to a transformed message. Range: 0.0-1.0.
Occasionally append a random action such as "*boops*" to the message.
Chance of appending an action text. Range: 0.0-1.0.
List of action texts that can be randomly appended when action texts are enabled.
Occasionally append a random emoticon to the message.
Chance of appending an emoticon. Range: 0.0-1.0.
List of emoticons that can be randomly appended when emoticons are enabled.
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.uwuifierWo: Chance for each eligible word to receive Uwuifier word transformations.
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.uwuifierEx: Replace trailing ! and ? punctuation with randomized Uwuifier-style combinations.
Chance of changing trailing exclamation/question punctuation.
Random punctuation combinations used by the exclamation effect.
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.leetSpeakE: Convert letters into common leetspeak substitutions such as 4, 3, 1, 0, 5 and 7.
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.leetSpeakC: Chance of applying Leet Speak to a message.
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.gamerSlang: Replace common words with gaming and internet slang such as "u", "ur", "rly" and "pls".
Chance of applying Gamer Slang to a message.
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.textSpeakE: Use texting and chat abbreviations such as "brb", "btw", "idk", "omg" and "rn".
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.textSpeakC: Chance of applying Text Speak to a message.
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.lolcatEnab: Give text a classic Lolcat-style spelling and grammar flavor.
text.fuckinguselessmod.config.lolcatChan: Chance of applying Lolcat conversion to a message.
